title: William D. Zabel '61 Professor of Practice in Human Rights
bio: Samantha Power served in the Biden-Harris Administration as the Administrator of the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID). She has returned to Harvard Law School as the William D. Zabel ’61 Professor of Practice in Human Rights, with a joint appointment at Harvard Kennedy School, where she is the Anna Lindh Professor of the Practice […]
